correctness.rationale: The explicit monotone benefit function realizes the unique even-neighbor best response. Symmetric \(\mathbb F_2\) linear algebra proves equilibrium existence on every finite simple undirected graph. On cluster graphs, an odd active count is exactly best-response satisfaction throughout its clique; each move increases the integer potential by one and permanently settles a previously even component, proving exact length and \(2^{n-c}\) equilibria. An induced \(P_3\) forces a four-flip strict cycle regardless of all other fixed inactive vertices. Bipartite Hamming parity and uniqueness of best response rule out cycles shorter than four. The actual packaged verify.py enumerated 33867 simple graphs to n=6, 14946 cluster profiles and 134356 strict witness moves; tests corroborate rather than replace the proof.

originality.rationale: The exact if-and-only-if finite-improvement classification on all simple undirected networks was compared as a statement against three accessible foundational full texts and targeted mathematical-record searches. The 2021 parity linear-system lemma establishes computable equilibria, not universal convergence. The 2023 convergence theorem assumes decreasing patterns, excluding the infinite alternating rule. The 2022 complexity paper addresses equilibrium decision problems, not arbitrary unilateral improving cycles. A related synchronous parity record changes every site simultaneously rather than allowing unilateral strictly improving flips, and so does not imply this criterion. Residual risk of an unindexed equivalent remains.
residual_risks: An equivalent forbidden-P3 improvement-dynamics classification could occur in unindexed game-theory or Boolean-network literature under different terminology.
The related synchronous parity record was matched by summary only, not read in full; its explicit synchronous transition rule makes direct implication inapplicable.
No independent expert or external audit has yet been performed.

value.rationale: The literature-motivated nonmonotone alternating public-goods rule has efficiently identifiable Nash equilibria, but their existence does not decide robustness under arbitrary sequential player adjustments. The exact \(P_3\)-free forbidden-induced-subgraph boundary gives a complete network-design criterion, a sharp minimal cycling obstruction and an exact schedule-independent convergence horizon across an infinite family. These structural facts are not merely a relabeled instance count and provide actionable separation between equilibrium existence and unavoidable convergence of improvement paths.
